Description: Reasoning told in every language Lambek reads (fr, en, de, es, nl, pt, it), the same conversations in each: all and no, a thing that is or does, with what it does to, a chain of two, the fact told first, and what cannot be concluded (a thing never told of, all read the other way, some, a thing told of another); and, since version 1.1, a thing told not to be, who is, what all are like, two told at once, no read through a chain and the other way, no with what it does to. Each case is a conversation of its own, measured as bench/messages.json is (Invoke-LambekMessageBenchmark). The calibration split and the test split say the same kinds of things with other words; the test split is frozen: TestHash is the hash of its cases, never edit them while working on Lambek (version 1.1 added cases to both splits, before Lambek was worked on with them). Written by hand, never learned from.
